name: @hasna/otp
description: Local encrypted OTP/TOTP manager for AI agent workflows

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/cli/index.ts --outdir dist/cli --target bun --external @modelcontextprotocol/sdk && bun build src/mcp/index.ts --outdir dist/mcp --target bun --external @modelcontextprotocol/sdk && bun build src/index.ts src/otpauth.ts src/storage.ts src/totp.ts src/types.ts --outdir dist --target bun && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist && rm -f dist/crypto.d.ts dist/crypto.d.ts.map && chmod +x dist/cli/index.js dist/mcp/index.js
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build

author: hasna
